work_identified: 't Nieuwe Jerusalem (Het Nieuwe Jeruzalem) — a posthumously published (1635) Dutch Further Reformation devotional by Willem Teellinck (1579–1629), written as a dialogue between Christ and Mary sitting at his feet. Distinct from Teellinck's other works and from the contemporaneous German translation (Sola Gratia Medien, 2021).

reasoning: No English translation of 't Nieuwe Jerusalem found anywhere. The four 17th-c Teellinck English translations (1621) all predate this posthumous 1635 work. Modern publisher Reformation Heritage Books/Baker Academic have issued The Path of True Godliness (2003) and The North Star (2021) but not this title. Only a German translation (2021) exists.
